---
name: Reproducibility report
about: Report a problem reproducing a script, protocol or documented result
title: "[Reproduction] "
---

## Expected and observed
What did you expect and what happened?

## Revision and environment
Repository revision, Python/instrument versions and relevant settings.

## Steps to reproduce
Provide minimal commands or protocol steps and non-sensitive records.

## Evidence level and impact
Synthetic or physical? Include calibration context if applicable.

## Proposed check
How would a fix be verified? Do not post secrets, private data or patient identifiers.
